intuition.title: Thiolactic acid links PbS to the nanotube host
intuition.text: The authors use thiolactic acid to attach PbS to TiO2 nanotubes. The both-surface route uses 0.6 M TLA; outer-surface DDAB blocking followed by 0.3 M TLA directs deposition into the pores. The lower TLA concentration was chosen in an effort to match size; a separate numerical inside-only size is not established.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2–3, Deposition and Figure 1 discussion

intuition.title: Charge and dye identity govern the assay comparison
intuition.text: Around pH 6 the TNT surfaces favor cationic-dye adsorption. Figures 2–4 report the order PbS/TNTs > TNTs > PbS/TNTs (in) > P25 for methylene blue, methylene green and rhodamine B. For indigo carmine and rose bengal, Figures 5–6 instead show P25 > PbS/TNTs > PbS/TNTs (in) > TNTs. These are source activity comparisons, not additional syntheses.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 3–4, Photocatalytic Activity and Figures 2–6

intuition.title: Inside-only deposition may restrict access
intuition.text: The authors propose that PbS in the pores reduces accessible TNT surface and that remaining blocking reagent may also reduce activity. These are proposed explanations; remaining DDAB and pore-blocking fractions are not measured quantitatively in the main.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 4, Inside-only catalyst interpretation

intuition.title: Filtered-light response supports a qualified transfer mechanism
intuition.text: With a Ray-sorb reactor filtering light below 600 nm, methylene-blue degradation is observed with PbS/TNTs whereas TNTs alone do not catalyze bleaching. Close contact through the linker is proposed to permit electron transfer. Literature energy levels and a size-dependent transfer limit are contextual estimates, not measured band alignment for a identified batch.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 4–5, Effect of PbS QDs and Figure 7

intuition.title: Recycling separates activity from catalyst recovery
intuition.text: Figure 8 compares three methylene-blue runs at a 30 min readout. The authors discuss incomplete particle recovery, possible corrosion and dye adsorption as explanations for changes. FTIR is said to show no PbS oxidation, but the spectrum is not shown. No exact bar values are digitized.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 5, Recyclability and Figure 8

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
